component.name: Qrypt
component.summary: Privacy-first text encryption, compression, and obfuscation

description.p: Qrypt is a flexible, privacy-first application for manual text encryption, compression, digital signing, and obfuscation. Designed for scenarios where end-to-end encryption is missing, restricted, or unavailable, Qrypt puts full control in the user's hands to exchange messages securely across any communication channel.

ul.li: Encryption Methods: AES-GCM (recommended default), AES-CBC, AES-CTR, RSA-OAEP-256, and post-quantum ML-KEM (512, 768, and 1024).
Digital Signatures: Post-quantum ML-DSA (Dilithium) and RSASSA-PSS (SHA-256) using Encrypt-then-Sign.
Compression Algorithms: GZip, LZ4, Brotli, and Zstandard (Zstd) with decompression bomb protection.
Obfuscation Techniques: Natural-language character mapping (EN1/EN2, FA1/FA2), custom QR-shareable profiles, Base64, ROT13, and XOR.
Smart Tagging System: Deterministic routing tags with single-tap auto-detection and verification.
Key Management: Generate, store, and share RSA, ML-KEM, ML-DSA, and AES keys locally with air-gapped QR sharing.

description.p: Updated core dependencies including oqs 4.3.0, asn1lib 1.6.9, and cupertino_icons 2.0.0.
Extracted dedicated output panel widgets, improved narrow-screen and text-scaling layout resilience, and refined release packaging.
Added direct 1-tap public key QR sharing shortcuts and expandable public key share cards for asymmetric and post-quantum algorithms.
Post-quantum cryptographic expansion, QR code viewing improvements, and custom map stability:

ul.li: Added multi-size ML-KEM support across all NIST FIPS 203 sizes (512, 768, 1024) with parameter badges.
Added QR code enlargement toggle and fullscreen interactive pinch-to-zoom viewer.
Fixed crash issues in custom map generation and dropdown profile selection.
Added pool-aware default naming and expanded character pool selections for custom obfuscation maps.

description.p: Security hardening, cryptographic modernization, and desktop enhancements:

ul.li: Migrated RSA signature scheme to genuine RSASSA-PSS (SHA-256 with 32-byte salt).
Added streaming decompression safety guard (25 MB ceiling) to prevent zip bomb Denial of Service.
Hardened AES decryption with strict odd-nibble hex string length validation.
Fixed PKCS#8 RSA private key export for full standard compliance with OpenSSL.
Aligned GTK desktop application ID for improved Wayland and taskbar integration.
Added air-gapped QR code sharing for ciphertexts and asymmetric/quantum public keys with oversized payload protections.
Added desktop keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Enter, Ctrl+M, Ctrl+Shift+C, Ctrl+L) and action tooltips.
Added persistent first-launch disclaimer and updated offline privacy policy.
